layout.title: Four models, every completed learning stage
layout.notes: This is a dedicated training/evaluation presentation rather than the full project-history deck. The requested four families are included; MiniCPM is outside this deck. Six CLIP visual runs, three SmolVLM LoRA runs and the corrected supervised VadCLIP study are documented. Later classifier, region and source-data studies are separated from genuine changes to pretrained backbone weights. No model is retrained for this documentation build and no speed or latency measurements are included.

layout.notes: The expansion adds 1,118 smoking photos: 715 training, 179 development and 224 test. layout.title: Linear probing and visual tuning change different weights
layout.notes: The probe pools ordered input image embeddings into normalized endpoint/mean/max/last-minus-first features. C is selected on development AP: primary MobileCLIP C10, SigLIP C100. Only one annotated target contributes BCE to visual tuning. Fine-tuning starts from the selected probe head, updates the recorded last-stage visual parameters, and applies feature distillation plus weight anchoring at coefficient0.1 each. Scene-preserving augmentation uses horizontal flip0.5, brightness/contrast0.15 and saturation0.1, without random crops. Float32 parameters with BF16 autocast train on GPU; final selection/calibration and held-out inference use float32 with TF32 disabled. Zero-shot uses a text direction on the endpoint embedding rather than the supervised temporal pooling, so that transition changes supervision and representation.

layout.title: After backbone training: regions, geometry and new heads
layout.notes: The expanded training/development pool is3,973/1,812. Automatic Faster R-CNN contextual crops have confidence 0.5,20% padding and full-frame fallback. Full pooled features use last/mean/max/change; ordered features concatenate four indexed frames plus mean/max. MLP uses one64-unit ReLU layer, dropout 0.3, AdamW LR 0.001/weight decay 0.01, batch 128, at most80 epochs and patience 8. Linear classifiers use LBFGS up to400 iterations. Visual interpolation uses only previously trained parameters. Primary selection maximizes mean development-source AP. Secondary worst-source analyses and later policies have their own timing qualifications.

layout.title: LoRA adapts the answer function while vision stays frozen
layout.notes: A sample contributes supervision only for its annotated target. The Yes/No first-token loss uses the whole vocabulary, with all prompt/image loss positions excluded. Vision tower, multimodal connector, token embeddings and vocabulary head are immutable. Rank 8alpha16dropout0.05 target seven projection types in language layers. Linear LR decay follows5% warmup; gradient norm clipping1.0. One epoch has7,946 visits: all3,973unique examples plus an equally sized task/class/source/group-balanced resample. Frozen vision tokens are512-pixel inputs without image splitting; static tasks1image, temporal windows4, littering8. Held-out logits are float32 with TF32 off. Original and adapted routes use identical prompts and images.
